title: FakeAgent reported public Claude Artifact
description: The exact public Claude Artifact URL reported in the FakeAgent campaign appears in a tool command or uniquely correlated network observation. General claude.ai traffic does not match.
falsepositives: Researchers may inspect the exact artifact.
The artifact may be removed or changed.
investigation: Confirm the exact artifact path and content at the time of access, follow redirects, and determine whether software was downloaded or executed.

classification.rationale: Visiting a reported artifact URL alone does not prove prompt injection or another AI-specific failure.
